title: Unary left derived functor from a left derivability structure
statement:
Let $A,D,H$ be categories [def-nagata-category], let $W$ be a class of arrows in $A$ containing identities, and let $L:A\to D$ be a localization at $W$ in the universal-property sense of [def-sfb-left-derivability-structure]. Let $i:P\to A$ be a full inclusion which is a left derivability structure [def-sfb-left-derivability-structure], with $W_P=i^{-1}W$. Suppose $F:A\to H$ is a functor such that $F\circ i$ sends every arrow of $W_P$ to an isomorphism. Then there exist a functor $LF:D\to H$ and a natural transformation $\varepsilon:LF\circ L\Rightarrow F$ such that for every $V:D\to H$, composition with $\varepsilon$ induces a bijection
$$\operatorname{Nat}(V,LF)\simeq\operatorname{Nat}(V\circ L,F).$$
For every functor $T:D\to H$ and natural transformation $\eta:T\circ L\Rightarrow F$, this universal property holds for $(T,\eta)$ if and only if each component $\eta_{iP}$ is an isomorphism. In particular $\varepsilon_{iP}$ is invertible for every $P\in P$.
